statement: Digital products can be refunded within 7 days if they have not been downloaded [F1]. Once a file has been downloaded, the sale is final [F2]. Download therefore ends eligibility for a refund within 7 days [F1] [F2].
notes: Digital products can be refunded within 7 days if they have not been downloaded (see refund-policy.pdf). Once a file has been downloaded, the sale is final (see refund-policy.pdf). Download therefore ends eligibility for a refund within 7 days (see refund-policy.pdf).
